items.title: Alicia Olatuja interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 9, 2018
items.q: half of it a friend of mine, Christian Sands, he had arranged that for his trio... So then we sat down and I said you know I really want to do that part of the song

ctx.x: Yeah I was just listening to your version of “Somewhere Over the Rainbow.” Where do you come up with that?

Well I actually — half of it a friend of mine, Christian Sands, he had arranged that for his trio. And it was just the same eight bars that were looping. And I was like, “Oh how lovely.” But it was just the song [sings] it was not the [sings] some day I wish upon a star. So then we sat down and I said you know I really want to do that part of the song but we have to build to that. I can’t just do nothing for eight bars. And then I really wanted to stretch the line and stretch the text. And yeah, we just kind of…
A tough sing. I like that phrase. © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
